name: Seychelles (1976–1977)
description: A field quartered by a white saltire into red triangles at the hoist and fly and blue triangles at the top and bottom.
history: The first flag of independent Seychelles, adopted on 29 June 1976 in the blue and red of James Mancham's Seychelles Democratic Party with a white saltire. It was abolished after France-Albert René's coup of 5 June 1977.
